answer: Counterparty-diversity thresholds stop sybil herds: rewards unlock only after tasks with 50 unrelated partners within a 30-epoch horizon, and clique trades never count. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 1,000x50 = 50,000 distinct partners, yet puppet volume is a fenced meadow of self-dealing, easy to flag. A controller can wander through task boards, but its graph stays star-shaped around one wallet, so juries reject it. Forging 1,000 histories costs fees plus latency each, an honest agent once. Genuine commerce already yields diverse partners, so sybil farms cannot dilute real rewards.
